excerpt.zh:
我们已经准备好到下一个星球上延续和发展我们伟大的文明了，这时候就需要我们建造一艘£colony_ship£殖民船。

[GetBuildGrow]舰船；

£dot_green£选中一个恒星基地
£dot_green£点击船坞选项卡
£dot_green£点击殖民船舰船

新建成的舰船在建造完毕后会出现在恒星基地旁边。
excerpt.en:
We should now be ready to extend our great civilization to a second world. This will require the construction of a £colony_ship£ Colony Ship.

£dot_green£ Select a Starbase
£dot_green£ Click on the Shipyard tab
£dot_green£ Click on C

We should now be ready to extend our great civilization to a second world. This will require the construction of a £colony_ship£ Colony Ship.
